A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In the aftermath of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] by the Imperials, the [[Old Galactic Market]] sector of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was taken over by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]]. In a bid to have them forciably removed, around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="DanielErickson">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5365704|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic - Question! :) - Page 3}} &mdash; This forum post from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]], indicates that the game takes place about ten to twelve years after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Treaty is signed in [[3653 BBY]], placing the Republic storylines in the Prologue around [[3643 BBY]].</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vanara Kayl]], leader of Coruscant's government, ordered the Coruscant Security Force under [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] [[Winborn]] to an [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|attack]] and force the guild out. At the time of the attack, the Guild was initiating a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] plot by attempting to hack into Coruscant's secure [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]] infrastructure in order to disrupt it and cause thousands of [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] to fall on the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. The Guild also disrupted communications between the CSF officers and Senator Kayl. Winborn ordered this individual who attempt to re-establish communications.<ref name="SWTORCiGC">{{TORcite|type=general|Crisis in Galactic City|Coruscant}}</ref>
